sources.note: Kroger App Store listing explicitly states 'Add your Plus Card to Apple Wallet' as a distinct feature from Kroger Pay, confirming native wallet pass support.
Kroger Pay uses a one-time in-app QR carrying the Shopper's Card and payment; Kroger's own method, separate from the Apple Wallet loyalty pass.
Apple Community (July 2026): user noted no native way to add Plus Card to Wallet — predates App Store listing update confirming Wallet support.
